𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. 1. Surjectivity. η is onto ℝ^P: for y ∈ ℝ^P, η(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹a + (λ⁻¹λ)y = y because λ ≠ 0. subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y, let μ be any measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) any map. If X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (Bochner integrals, with value 0 for non-integrable integrands), then X'(ω) = ∫ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) d(ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ)(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), where η_*μ = Measure.map (dilation a λ) μ.

Conventions. ℝ^P = Euclid P; η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a), λ > 0. For V ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(V) = TestFormOn V k is the space of C^∞ k-forms ω on ℝ^P (maps to k-covectors) with compact tsupport ω ⊆ V; its elements are determined by their underlying forms. 𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), X' is a dilation of X when X'(ω) = λ^{−k}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. η_#Y := η_{a,λ#}Y = blowUp Y a λ ∈ 𝒟_k(η(U)) for Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U). Sibling names refer to the children of this decomposition: testform_correspondence = dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr, blowup_structure = dtc_blowUp_algebra, rep_pushforward = dtc_blowUp_imrep, mass_scaling = dtc_blowUp_massOn_image, dilation_blowup = cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp.
Fix ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P).
1. η is onto ℝ^P: for y ∈ ℝ^P, η(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹a + (λ⁻¹λ)y = y because λ ≠ 0. Hence ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P), i.e. η(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, so every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) is also an element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) with the same underlying form (tsupport ω ⊆ ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P); SimonGMT testFormOnInclusion), and every element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) is an element of 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with the same underlying form. Let ω₁ ∈ 𝒟^m(η(ℝ^P)) be ω regarded in η(ℝ^P). By testform_correspondence (a) (U = ℝ^P, x = a, n = m) there is ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω₁(η(y)) = ω(η(y)) for all y.
2. By the dilation property for the pair ω, ω' and the representation of X: X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω'(x)) dμ(x) = λ^{−m}∫ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x), the last step because the integrands agree at every x.

subproblem.title: The boundary of a dilation is the dilation of the boundary

Then ∂X'(ω) = λ^{−m}∂X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y, where ∂Y(φ) = Y(dφ) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary).

subproblem.title: A dilation of an integer multiplicity current is integer multiplicity
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. If X is integer multiplicity (X = τ(M, θ, ξ) for some IMRep (M, θ, ξ) in ℝ^P; contract IsIntegerMultiplicity), then X' is integer multiplicity.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X'

For V ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(V) = TestFormOn V k is the space of C^∞ k-forms ω on ℝ^P (maps to k-covectors) with compact tsupport ω ⊆ V; its elements are determined by their underlying forms. 𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), X' is a dilation of X when X'(ω) = λ^{−k}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. η_#Y := η_{a,λ#}Y = blowUp Y a λ ∈ 𝒟_k(η(U)) for Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U). Sibling names refer to the children of this decomposition: testform_correspondence = dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr, blowup_structure = dtc_blowUp_algebra, rep_pushforward = dtc_blowUp_imrep, mass_scaling = dtc_blowUp_massOn_image, dilation_blowup = cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp.
An IMRep in a domain U (contract IMRep U m) is a triple (M, θ, ξ) with M Borel, M ⊆ U, M countably m-rectifiable, θ : ℝ^P → ℕ measurable with θ > 0 on M and ∫_{M∩K} θ dHᵐ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) a.e. strongly measurable for Hᵐ⌞M, and, for Hᵐ⌞M-a.e. y, ξ(y) a unit orientation of some Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M y Q (Hᵐ = μHE[m]). R.action(φ) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(φ(y)) dHᵐ(y) depends only on the triple and on the underlying form φ; R represents T ∈ 𝒟_m(U) iff T(φ) = R.action(φ) for all φ ∈ 𝒟^m(U).

M' ⊆ ℝ^P trivially. Local integrability: if K ⊆ ℝ^P is compact, then K ⊆ η(ℝ^P) by step 2, so ∫_{M'∩K} θ' dHᵐ < ∞ by the local integrability of R' in η(ℝ^P).

subproblem.title: Mass scaling for dilations: M_{η(W)}(X′) = λ^{−m}M_W(X)
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. Then for every W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_{η(W)}(X') = ofReal(λ^{−m})·M_W(X) in [0,∞], where M_V(Y) = sup{ofReal(Y(ω)) : ω ∈ 𝒟^m(dom Y), tsupport ω ⊆ V, |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y} with |·| the Euclidean coefficient norm (SimonGMT massOn).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), X'.massOn (dilation a lam '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) * X.massOn W
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 9 of the parent proof (admissible forms for η(W) and for W correspond via ω ↦ ω∘η, and multiplication by ofReal(λ^{−m}) commutes with suprema); this correspondence is the sibling mass_scaling for the blow-up η_#X, and dilation_blowup identifies X' with η_#X on equal forms.
Conventions. ℝ^P = Euclid P; η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a), λ > 0. For V ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(V) = TestFormOn V k is the space of C^∞ k-forms ω on ℝ^P (maps to k-covectors) with compact tsupport ω ⊆ V; its elements are determined by their underlying forms. 𝒟_k(V) = GeometricCurrentOn V k. For X, X' ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), X' is a dilation of X when X'(ω) = λ^{−k}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y. η_#Y := η_{a,λ#}Y = blowUp Y a λ ∈ 𝒟_k(η(U)) for Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U). Sibling names refer to the children of this decomposition: testform_correspondence = dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr, blowup_structure = dtc_blowUp_algebra, rep_pushforward = dtc_blowUp_imrep, mass_scaling = dtc_blowUp_massOn_image, dilation_blowup = cbr_cidc_dilation_exists_eq_blowUp.
For a domain D ⊆ ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^P let Adm(D, V) := {φ ∈ 𝒟^m(D) : tsupport φ ⊆ V and |φ(y)| ≤ 1 for all y} (SimonGMT massAdmissibleOn D m V), so that M_V(Y) = sup{ofReal(Y(φ)) : φ ∈ Adm(D, V)} for Y ∈ 𝒟_m(D). Membership in Adm(D, V) depends only on the underlying form of φ and on D only through φ ∈ 𝒟^m(D).
1. η is onto ℝ^P: for y ∈ ℝ^P, η(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹(a + λy) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹a + (λ⁻¹λ)y = y because λ ≠ 0. Hence ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P), i.e. η(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, so every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) is also an element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) with the same underlying form (tsupport ω ⊆ ℝ^P ⊆ η(ℝ^P); SimonGMT testFormOnInclusion), and every element of 𝒟^k(η(ℝ^P)) is an element of 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) with the same underlying form.
2. Claim: M_V(X') = M_V(η_#X) for every V ⊆ ℝ^P (X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P), η_#X ∈ 𝒟_m(η(ℝ^P))). Let A := {ofReal(X'(φ)) : φ ∈ Adm(ℝ^P, V)} and B := {ofReal(η_#X(φ₁)) : φ₁ ∈ Adm(η(ℝ^P), V)}. (⊆) If φ ∈ Adm(ℝ^P, V), its copy φ₁ ∈ 𝒟^m(η(ℝ^P)) (step 1) has the same underlying form, hence φ₁ ∈ Adm(η(ℝ^P), V), and X'(φ) = η_#X(φ₁) by dilation_blowup (ii); so ofReal(X'(φ)) ∈ B. (⊇) If φ₁ ∈ Adm(η(ℝ^P), V), its copy φ ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (tsupport φ₁ ⊆ η(ℝ^P) ⊆ ℝ^P) has the same underlying form, hence φ ∈ Adm(ℝ^P, V), and X'(φ) = η_#X(φ₁) by dilation_blowup (ii); so ofReal(η_#X(φ₁)) ∈ A. Thus A = B and M_V(X') = sup A = sup B = M_V(η_#X).
3. Apply step 2 with V = η(W) and then mass_scaling with U = ℝ^P, n = m, T = X, x = a and W: M_{η(W)}(X') = M_{η(W)}(η_#X) = ofReal(λ^{−m})·M_W(X). No hypothesis on W or m was used. ∎
Formalization notes (proved in a scratch build from the exact sibling types): rw [← mass_scaling P m univ X a λ hlam W]; unfold GeometricCurrentOn.massOn; congr 1; ext r; in each direction rintro ⟨φ, ⟨hs, hn⟩, rfl⟩, refine ⟨testFormOnInclusion _ m φ, ⟨hs, hn⟩, ?_⟩ (with hsurj, resp. subset_univ _), dsimp only, and rewrite with (dilation_blowup P m a λ hlam).2 X X' hX φ (testFormOnInclusion hsurj m φ) rfl, resp. (dilation_blowup P m a λ hlam).2 X X' hX (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ _) m φ₁) φ₁ rfl (the test-form arguments must be explicit for rfl to elaborate).
proof_key_steps: η(ℝ^P) = ℝ^P, so admissible forms for X' (domain ℝ^P) and for η_#X (domain η(ℝ^P)) on any V are the same forms.
dilation_blowup (ii) gives X'(φ) = η_#X(φ₁) for corresponding forms, so M_V(X') = M_V(η_#X).
mass_scaling with V = η(W): M_{η(W)}(η_#X) = ofReal(λ^{−m})M_W(X).

audit.reason: Copies of the same underlying form across the equal domains preserve admissibility and evaluations in both directions. Equality of the supremum sets followed by mass_scaling proves the exact conclusion for every W.
